_readme: Sample-site history that is APPLIED to the shared project but is deliberately
NOT part of the Portrox bootstrap and NOT mirrored into packages/database.
These granted anon broad rights on the old contact/projects tables; those
tables are now deny-all. A fresh tenant must never receive them.
scripts/verify-migrations.mjs requires every supabase/migrations/*.sql to be
either byte-mirrored via MIRROR_MAP or declared here with a reason.

legacy.20261105150250_init_schema.sql: Original sample-site schema: created public.contact_messages and the old projects table. Superseded by portrox_init; tables now deny-all.
legacy.20261105154308_fix_anon_grants.sql: Granted schema usage and table rights to anon for the sample frontend. Revoked by legacy_lockdown and drop_legacy_policies.
Granted anon INSERT on the old projects table. Table renamed to legacy_projects and locked.
legacy.20261110074431_fix_contact_permissions.s: GRANT ALL to anon on contact_messages. Reversed by legacy_lockdown; table now has zero client grants.
legacy.20261110190000_contact_messages_rls.sql: Allowed anon INSERT on contact_messages. Replaced by the portrox_submit intake door; table now deny-all.
legacy.20261113120000_contact_hardening.sql: Self-healing hardening of the old contact endpoint. Superseded by the Portrox intake RPCs.
legacy.20261117210000_rename_legacy_projects.sq: Freed the name public.projects for Portrox by renaming the sample table to legacy_projects. Conditional no-op on a fresh tenant.
